faqs.question: How long does a typical AI for Customer Support engagement take?
faqs.answer: Most support AI pilots launch in 4–10 weeks, including knowledge cleanup, integrations, and agent assist / deflection flows.

faqs.question: Do you work with existing teams and tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. We integrate with Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, HubSpot, and custom helpdesks, and we train agents on the new workflows.

faqs.question: How do you measure success?
faqs.answer: Deflection rate, average handle time, CSAT/NPS, first-contact resolution, and agent adoption of assist tools.

faqs.question: Agent assist or full automation?
faqs.answer: Both are options. Many teams start with assist (draft replies, macros, retrieval) then expand automation where confidence is high.

faqs.question: What if our knowledge base is messy?
faqs.answer: Common. Discovery includes a knowledge triage: prioritize high-volume intents, rewrite answer sources, and retire conflicting articles.

faqs.question: How do you protect brand and compliance?
faqs.answer: Approved sources only, tone guidelines, restricted actions, audit logs, and escalation for refunds, legal, or account-sensitive topics.

faqs.question: Can this reduce after-hours backlog?
faqs.answer: Yes. Self-serve deflection and async triage keep nights/weekends from piling up while preserving human coverage for priority cases.

faqs.question: Will agents trust the system?
faqs.answer: We design with agents, not around them — visible citations, editable drafts, and clear override paths drive adoption.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: Share ticket volume themes and your helpdesk stack. We propose a pilot on the top 10 intents with clear success gates.

faqs.question: Who is on the delivery team?
faqs.answer: CX/automation lead, conversation designer, and integration engineer, with weekly reviews against support KPIs.
